scope: source-level protections and open audits, not current-worker or profitability certification

modes.protection: one entry selector, one management selector and one broker mutator
file-level review tripwire; full data-flow analysis remains open

modes.detection: successive policy adjustments on the same decision fact
modes.protection: versioned policy registry exists, but all score transformations have not been proven independent

modes.detection: optional missing evidence turns into Paper HOLD or WAIT
modes.protection: shadow diagnostic and canonical frontier preserve optional versus required evidence

modes.detection: research-only feature becomes required for Paper Q
modes.protection: 20-family roles and per-strategy manifest; future consumers still need review

modes.detection: correlated IV, premium, skew or trend features gain multiple weights
modes.protection: no new Production score has been added; a quantitative overlap audit remains

modes.detection: same OCC contract produces multiple Q or D alternatives
modes.protection: identical observations collapse; conflicting observations fail the affected branch closed

modes.detection: future or stale quote enters a decision
modes.protection: frozen T0 rejects future observations; execution quote freshness is a separate hard gate

modes.detection: strategy or policy hash changes under an existing version
modes.protection: version store rejects hash mismatch; runtime exact-SHA proof remains separate

modes.detection: offline vector disagrees with a frozen serving vector
modes.protection: PIT feature tests exist; no promoted model or representative resolved outcomes yet

modes.detection: future specialist models issue conflicting evidence
modes.protection: no specialist model may select or mutate a broker order

modes.detection: nearby frozen cycles flip action without a material input change
modes.protection: tie determinism is tested; temporal oscillation measurement is not

modes.detection: Q, D-shadow and WAIT alternate near a boundary
modes.protection: comparison is research-only; no arbitrary hysteresis has been installed

modes.detection: training denominator omits rejected or WAIT candidates
modes.protection: selection-bias receipt exists; future complete outcomes are required

modes.detection: promoted policy learns only from its chosen trades
modes.protection: shadow alternatives and WAIT research stay outside broker authority

modes.detection: H/D or optional research failure earns Paper GLOBAL_WAIT
modes.protection: only evaluated Q may earn Paper GLOBAL_WAIT

modes.detection: unexplained excess new-risk frequency or turnover
modes.protection: observational metrics retain denominators; no empirical thresholds are invented

modes.detection: unbounded dominance or T0 payload reaches operational persistence
modes.protection: frontier witness IDs and T0 payload are bounded, with exact rank and explicit omitted count

modes.detection: two broker submissions for one intent
modes.protection: single coordinator owns broker mutation and intent idempotency
